description: This PHP file defines a controller class 'Sale' for the OpenCart admin dashboard extension. It handles displaying a sales dashboard widget, saving configuration settings, and generating sales data metrics for display.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Controller class for managing the sales dashboard widget in OpenCart admin.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the sales dashboard configuration form page, including breadcrumbs, header, footer, and module settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the dashboard sale configuration settings via POST request, with permission checks.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates the sales data metrics for the dashboard widget, including total sales, percentage change, and links to sales pages.
